integrity: All claims are deduced from the stated finite-state continuous-time process; jump directions each have rate one; independent external validation is absent.
scientific_limitations: For N>4 only existence, not uniqueness, of a sign reversal is established. Full nearest-neighbor negativity is proved on N=4, not on arbitrary cycles. Numerical checks are finite corroboration. Possible uncatalogued multi-interval finite-ring literature overlap remains; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Reset-induced long-range correlation reversal in finite coalescing rings
